description: This Java class 'MidiFramer' processes MIDI byte streams, parsing incoming bytes into MIDI messages and forwarding them to a specified receiver. It handles different MIDI message types including System Exclusive and Running Status, and manages message boundaries within the byte stream.

classes.name: MidiFramer
classes.description: A class that extends MidiReceiver to parse incoming MIDI byte streams into discrete messages, handling special cases like SysEx and Running Status.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides the onSend method to process incoming MIDI data bytes, parse complete messages, and forward them to the receiver.
